title: Pi oracle extension configuration
description: Configuration for configs/agents/pi/extensions/oracle, normally stored at ~/.pi/oracle.json.

$schema.description: Optional editor schema reference. From ~/.pi/oracle.json, use ./agent/extensions/oracle/oracle.schema.json.

chatgpt.description: ChatGPT Web impersonation settings for the oracle tool.

browser.description: Local browser whose cookies should be used for chatgpt.com. The model never chooses this in tool calls.

profile.description: Browser profile name signed into chatgpt.com.

model.description: ChatGPT Web model id used by the oracle. Defaults to GPT-5.6 Sol Pro.

projectId.description: Optional ChatGPT project id. When set, Oracle conversations are created inside this project.

timeoutMs.description: Overall timeout for a single oracle request.

pollIntervalMs.description: Polling interval while waiting for the ChatGPT conversation answer.
